summary: Military aircraft, including fast jets, will conduct high energy manoeuvres within 12 nautical miles of Topcliffe, between 3,000 and 21,500 feet.
text:
MIL ACFT, INCLUDING FAST JETS, WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEVRES
WI 12NM RADIUS OF 541220N 0012256W (TOPCLIFFE). ACFT MAY BE UNABLE 
TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR INFO 01343 817115. AR-2026-10786/01.
